item.title: Machine Hermeneutics: the building that explains what the machine found
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: once machines do science faster than people can read it, explanation becomes a line of work with its own ledger. This year’s ledger can already be counted, and three different things are still being asked to justify it. 1. Two hundred and seventy-one rows on a screen# Half of my screen holds a tracker page kept by a mathematician.

item.title: One photon at a time, and a trace too wide for one photon
item.description: The Chinese page is the default version of this article. Read it in Chinese → This English page stays at this URL; the Chinese one is the version maintained first. One line Turn the light down until one photon passes at a time, and the screen still grows stripes that take many photons to explain. Every reading of that sentence carries a bill. I keep a laser pointer in a drawer, the sort that costs a few dollars and puts a bright dot on a wall.
